text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahh, I was so close… I know it's not that bad a result, but it's still frustrating…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haha… I guess I'm still a step short from claiming victory…
choice_data_list: But you gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Yeah, you're right! I did!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But I'm still upset that I didn't make it to first place…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Heavy is the trophy that slipped from your grasp"… I'll just have to train harder. Then victory will be even sweeter!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're right… I can't simply accept the placement I got this time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "To see the light, you must run toward it!" I need to train more to make sure I place first next time!
